The name reminds the bearer to constantly strive for spiritual growth and material success, balancing both aspects of life.

historical_references.reference: The name Tanviya is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Tanu' meaning body and 'Vyoma' meaning space or sky. According to Hindu mythology, Tanviya was the name of a celestial nymph or apsara, who was in love with the god Indra. This reference is from ancient Hindu mythology.

In medieval India, Tanviya was the name of a renowned Sanskrit poetess, who composed verses on various Indian philosophies and spiritual practices. Her works were highly regarded in Indian literary circles.
